dishes.name: Tantuni
dishes.desc: Finely chopped beef sautéed on a hot plate with tomato, pepper and oil, wrapped in thin lavash. Mersin's best-known street food.

dishes.name: Cezerye
dishes.desc: A chewy sweet made from carrot syrup, coconut and nuts, a speciality of Tarsus and Mersin. Sold in boxes as the souvenir of the coast.

dishes.name: Batırık
dishes.desc: A thick Tarsus dish of bulgur, chickpeas and herbs, closer to a main course than a soup. Eaten at local lokantas.

dishes.name: Kerebiç
dishes.desc: A rolled sweet with pistachio or walnut and syrup, associated with Silifke and Cilicia. Often eaten at celebrations.

dishes.name: Yüksük çorbası
dishes.desc: A soup of tiny dumplings in a yogurt and chickpea broth, a dish of the Cilician plain. Served at Mersin home-cooking restaurants.
